主分析完成（脚本已执行，输出见 results_summary.txt / run_main.log）。

【最终假设（提交用，英文）】
In the sample of original papers underlying these large-scale replication projects — table 1 `meta-regression_study_data_heterogeneity_in_replication_projects.csv` (927 rows / 141 unique O/R pairs), where original-paper length is the field `length` (number of pages) and the two categories are defined only by the key `project` (`ee` = Experimental Economics, `rpp` = Psychology; `discipline`==`Economics` is exactly the 18 `ee` rows and `journal` is not used for screening) — Experimental Economics original papers average 28.0 pages (n = 18), whereas Psychology (rpp) original papers average 11.22 pages (n = 97). The difference is 16.78 pages, i.e. econ originals are about 2.5× as long (bootstrap 95% CI for the difference 13.3–20.4 pages; for the ratio 2.12–2.95). We hypothesise that the gap is driven at least partly by field/journal length conventions rather than by research scale or quality: all 18 `ee` papers come from AER/QJE, whose articles routinely carry figures, tables and appendices in the main page count (range 16–45 pages, median 27.5), while `rpp` originals are Psychological Science / JPSP / JEPLMC articles including 2–3 page short reports (median 9, range 1–31, right-skewed). This is a statement about the papers in this replication sample, not a general claim about the two disciplines.

【中文要点】实验经济学（project=='ee'）原始论文平均 28.0 页（n=18），心理学（project=='rpp'）平均 11.216 页（n=97）；差 16.784 页、倍数 2.496；中位数 27.5 vs 9.0，SD 7.37 vs 6.30，IQR 6.5（23.5–30.0）vs 9.0（7–16），极值 16–45 vs 1–31，偏度 +0.78 vs +0.62。检验：Welch t=9.06 (df=21.9, p=7.4e-09)、Mann–Whitney U=1681.5 (p=4.5e-10)、Cohen's d=2.59、rank-biserial +0.926（正号=ee 更长）。

【与此前诊断预览的一致性】主数值完全一致（ee 28.000、rpp 11.216），无静默替换。需明确更正一处：我在方案阶段估计"极短记录对均值拉动约 0.05 页"偏低——实测剔除 length==1 的 1 条为 −0.106 页（11.216→11.323），剔除全部 8 条 length≤3 为 −0.784 页（11.216→12.000）。另外首版脚本 rank-biserial 符号写反（−0.926），已在复跑中改为 +0.926 并注明方向，量级不变。

【敏感性表（两侧均值，逐项）】
1 主口径 ee vs rpp：28.000 (n=18) vs 11.216 (n=97)，差 16.784，比 2.496
2 剔除 drop==True：28.000 (18) vs 11.000 (90)，差 17.000，比 2.545
3 按 title 去重（篇）：28.000 (18) vs 11.232 (95)，差 16.768，比 2.493
4 剔除 length≤3：28.000 (18) vs 12.000 (89)，差 16.000，比 2.333
4b 仅剔除 length==1：28.000 (18) vs 11.323 (96)，差 16.677，比 2.473
5 ee 仅保留 AER（去 2 篇 QJE）：26.875 (16) vs 11.216 (97)，差 15.659，比 2.396
6 Psychology 扩为 rpp+ml1+ml3（行级，仅对照）：28.000 (18) vs 10.147 (909)，比 2.759
7 同上按原始论文去重（123 篇，仅对照）：28.000 (18) vs 11.065 (123)，比 2.530
→ 8 种口径下比值稳定在 2.33–2.76，方向与量级结论不变。参考：按论文去重后各项目均值 ml1 8.875 (16)、ml3 13.100 (10)、rpp 11.216 (97)、ee 28.000 (18)；rpp 内部 Cognitive 10.262 (42) vs Social 11.945 (55)（仅描述，不参与筛选）。

【数据质量报告】表1 927 行×57 列、141 个唯一 id（行/论文 = 6.58，多行仅源于 ml1/ml3 多实验室）；ee 18 行=18 id、rpp 97 行=97 id，子集断言 0 重复 id、0 缺失 length 通过（assert 未失败）；length 在全部 141 个 id 内部恒定，故论文级去重安全；length 全表 int64 零缺失，未插补；aggregated==True 共 26 行全在 ml1/ml3（目标类别内为 0）；drop==True 共 118 行（ml1 111、rpp 7、ee 0，主口径保留 rpp 那 7 条）；rpp 的 id 编号 1–167 中仅出现 97 个（58%），说明本表是复现项目的入选子集而非全量目标库；表2（143×15）无任何篇幅字段，仅确认 Experimental Economics 18 条与 ee 18 行对应，未参与计算。

【主要限制】(1) ee 侧 n=18 且全部来自 AER(16)/QJE(2)，均值对个别长文敏感（去 2 篇 QJE 后降至 26.9）；(2) `length` 字段的采集规则（是否含附录/图表/参考文献）在两学科间可能不一致，无法从数据内核实；(3) rpp 明显右偏且含 8 条 ≤3 页记录，故以 bootstrap CI + 秩检验与 t 检验并列；(4) rpp 跳号子集与"入选复现的研究"这一选择机制使样本不是两个学科的概率样本，不能外推为学科一般论断；(5) 页数作为篇幅代理无法区分信息密度。

Medians are 27.5 vs 9.0 pages (SD 7.37 vs 6.30; IQR 23.5-30.0 vs 7-16; range 16-45 vs 1-31, right-skewed on the psychology side). We hypothesise that this gap is at least partly a product of field/journal length conventions rather than of research scale or quality: all 18 ee papers are AER/QJE articles whose page counts include figures, tables and appendices, while the rpp originals are Psychological Science / JPSP / JEPLMC articles that include 2-3 page short reports. payload.workflow: 1) Profiled both tables; confirmed table2 (143x15) has no length field, so it was used only to cross-check that its 18 'Experimental Economics' studies correspond to the 18 ee rows. 2) Verified row/id structure: 927 rows = 141 unique ids; ee 18 rows=18 ids and rpp 97 rows=97 ids; asserted 0 duplicate ids and 0 missing `length` in the ee+rpp subset (115 rows); confirmed `length` is constant within all 141 ids. 3) Filtered project in {ee, rpp} (no discipline/journal filtering; confirmed ee disciplines == {Economics}); kept drop==True rows, same-title multiple target effects and very short records per the approved spec. 4) Computed per-group n, mean, median, SD, IQR, min/max and skewness; bootstrap 95% CIs (20000 resamples, seed 20261023) for both means, the difference and the ratio; Welch t-test and Mann-Whitney U plus Cohen's d and rank-biserial. 5) Built an 8-row sensitivity table (main; exclude drop==True; dedup by title; exclude length<=3; exclude only length==1; ee restricted to AER; Psychology widened to rpp+ml1+ml3 at row level and at paper level). 6) Produced a data-quality report (id/row relations, flag distributions, rpp id gaps 97 of 1-167, extreme-value inventory and their pull on the mean). Executed with python3/pandas 3.0.2/scipy 1.16.0; full console output preserved in run_main.log and results_summary.txt.
